description: This file defines traits, case classes, and a class related to Spark Streaming event listeners, including event handling and statistics reporting for streaming batches.

classes.name: StreamingListenerEvent
classes.description: Base trait for events related to StreamingListener

classes.name: StreamingListenerBatchSubmitted
classes.description: Event indicating a batch has been submitted

classes.name: StreamingListenerBatchCompleted
classes.description: Event indicating a batch has completed

classes.name: StreamingListenerBatchStarted
classes.description: Event indicating a batch has started

classes.name: StreamingListenerOutputOperationStarted
classes.description: Event indicating output operation has started

classes.name: StreamingListenerOutputOperationCompleted
classes.description: Event indicating output operation has completed

classes.name: StatsReportListener
classes.description: A listener that logs statistics across Spark Streaming batches

methods.name: onReceiverError

methods.name: onReceiverStopped
methods.description: Called when a receiver has been stopped

methods.name: onBatchSubmitted
methods.description: Called when a batch has been submitted

methods.name: onBatchStarted

methods.name: onBatchCompleted
methods.description: Called when a batch processing has completed

methods.name: onOutputOperationStarted
